title: CMakeLists.txt, CMakePresets.json, build_all.sh (CLion-bundled cmake), JUCE submodule pinned to shred-width tag
description:
Create the ShredDouble CMake scaffold and build entrypoints, sole owner of CMakeLists.txt in this phase.

Before editing, inspect:
- ~/dev/mike/music/plugins/shred-width/CMakeLists.txt (nSpace juce_add_plugin structure, SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER, clap-juce-extensions optional path, target_sources pattern)
- ~/dev/mike/music/plugins/shred-width/CMakePresets.json
- ~/dev/mike/music/plugins/shred-width/scripts/build_all.sh (find_cmake CLion candidates; cmake not on PATH)
- ~/dev/mike/music/plugins/shred-width/.gitmodules (JUCE tag 8.0.13 / commit 7c9d3783)
- .abracapocus/ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §§10, 13, 15

Implement:
1. CMakeLists.txt for project ShredDouble VERSION 1.0.0, C++20, mirroring shred-width:
   - option SHREDWIDTH_CONFIGURE_ONLY and SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER cache (default 2, strings 2|4)
   - require JUCE submodule at JUCE/; add_subdirectory(JUCE)
   - optional clap-juce-extensions EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL when present
   - juce_add_plugin(ShredDouble) FORMATS VST3 CLAP LV2 Standalone; COMPANY_NAME "nSpace Systems"; PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE NSPC; unique PLUGIN_CODE (e.g. ShDb); BUNDLE_ID com.nspacesystems.shreddouble; LV2URI urn:nspacesystems:plugin:shreddouble; IS_SYNTH FALSE; NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT FALSE
   - clap_juce_extensions_plugin when available (CLAP_ID com.nspacesystems.shreddouble)
   - target_sources PRIVATE listing Source/PluginProcessor.cpp, PluginEditor.cpp, StateManager.cpp and all Source/DSP/*.cpp and Source/GUI/*.cpp for the eight reused components (PitchShifter, DelayLineFrac, MonoSafetyCrossover, WidthProcessor, CustomLookAndFeel, RotarySlider, GoniometerComponent, CorrelationMeter). Do not invent Engine/Velocity files not yet created in later phases—if a source is phase-later, either omit it until that phase's sole CMake owner adds it, or register only files this phase expects to exist after waves complete. Prefer registering the reused + spine files this phase owns.
   - target_compile_definitions / juce recommended flags parity with shred-width; link juce::juce_audio_utils etc. as shred-width does
   - expose SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER to the target compile definitions if shred-width does
2. CMakePresets.json: linux-relwithdebinfo configure/build/test presets, binaryDir build/linux-relwithdebinfo, Unix Makefiles, cmake 3.22+
3. scripts/build_all.sh: executable bash; find_cmake() PATH then CLion Toolbox/snap/flatpak candidates (copy pattern from shred-width); cmake --preset linux-relwithdebinfo; build ShredDouble_VST3 ShredDouble_LV2 ShredDouble_Standalone and ShredDouble_CLAP if clap-juce-extensions present
4. .gitmodules + git submodule add/pin JUCE to the same URL/tag/commit as shred-width (8.0.13 / 7c9d3783b127263d72bb65fe0a7e2dc8a02a7ac2). Do not vendor full JUCE trees into the commit beyond submodule metadata unless the repo already has JUCE populated.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: CMakeLists.txt exists and defines project(ShredDouble ...) with C++20 and juce_add_plugin formats VST3 CLAP LV2 Standalone
CMakeLists.txt exposes SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER cache option defaulting to 2
CMakeLists.txt registers Source/PluginProcessor.cpp Source/PluginEditor.cpp Source/StateManager.cpp and the eight reused DSP/GUI .cpp files under target_sources
CMakePresets.json defines linux-relwithdebinfo configure and build presets with binaryDir build/linux-relwithdebinfo
scripts/build_all.sh exists, is executable, contains find_cmake with CLion-bundled cmake candidates, and builds ShredDouble_* format targets
.gitmodules pins submodule JUCE to tag 8.0.13 (same pin as shred-width)
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: edit or rewrite any file under the JUCE/ tree contents beyond submodule pointer metadata

allowed: mirror shred-width CMake/nSpace plugin metadata with ShredDouble-specific codes and bundle IDs
register only source files expected to exist after phase a waves
forbidden: introduce a different build system than CMake+presets
pin JUCE to a different tag than shred-width
implement DSP or GUI logic in CMake files
